result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards render correctly. Two visual defects stand out: the horizontal OS home indicator bar is drawn on top of the bottom navigation icons (overlapping the search and bookmark icons), and the third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped at the right edge (expected carousel behavior, not reported). Additionally, the bottom tab bar icons lack labels and the home indicator overlap harms usability. One minor contrast concern: the gray placeholder/metadata text on the light background is fairly low contrast.

issues.description: The device home indicator (horizontal black bar) is rendered overlapping the bottom navigation bar, sitting on top of the search and bookmark/order icons and obscuring them.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) so the tab bar content sits above the home indicator, or give the tab bar enough height/background so the indicator does not overlap interactive icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders, profile) have no text labels and the inactive icons are low-contrast gray, making them hard to identify, especially with the home indicator overlapping.
issues.suggestion: Add small text labels under each tab icon and increase contrast of inactive icons to meet WCAG guidelines.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses a light gray on the off-white background, resulting in borderline low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to at least 4.5:1 contrast against the background.
